top_stories.title: 18 insights from SailPoint’s Navigate event: Enterprises race to bring identity security for AI agents up to machine speed
top_stories.summary: SailPoint's Navigate event surfaced 18 key insights on how enterprises are approaching identity security for AI agents. Key themes include AI agents accumulating unintended access privileges at scale and the resulting pressure on identity governance systems to operate at machine speed.

top_stories.title: Tenable Identity Exposure SaaS Has CVSS 9.9 Command Injection That Hands Attackers SYSTEM on the Domain Controller
top_stories.summary: A critical command injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-106126, CVSS 9.9) has been discovered in Tenable Identity Exposure's SaaS platform. The flaw, classified as CWE-78, allows attackers to gain SYSTEM-level access on domain controllers.

top_stories.title: The Third-Party Agent Problem: Why Security Built for AI You Chose Misses the Agents You Didn't
top_stories.summary: A report on agent security finds that in studied environments, approximately 1,280 third-party products embed AI agents, but only 282 authenticate through SSO, leaving roughly 1,000 outside identity governance visibility. The "2026 State of Agent Security Report" highlights a structural gap in IAM coverage where agentic AI systems bypass identity infrastructure by not authenticating through it.

top_stories.title: The AI Velocity Paradox: Why Security Is Decades Behind AI Ambition
top_stories.summary: SailPoint's "Horizons of Identity Security" report identifies a "velocity paradox" where enterprises deploy autonomous AI agents while relying on legacy, human-speed identity security architectures. The report highlights the gap between AI-driven business operations and outdated security controls as a critical challenge for identity security programs.

top_stories.title: Citrix Patches Critical NetScaler Flaw That Could Enable RCE in SAML Deployments
top_stories.summary: Citrix has released patches for a critical memory overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-107406) in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway that can enable remote code execution or denial-of-service. The flaw specifically affects SAML deployments, making it directly relevant to IAM professionals managing federated identity and SSO infrastructure.

news.title: No Identity, No Recovery: Cyber Resilience Starts With IAM
news.summary: The article argues that cyber resilience strategies must prioritize identity and access management as a foundational element. The piece addresses the growing complexity of enterprise app sprawl and reliance on cloud identity providers as drivers for rethinking identity security approaches.

news.title: Credential-Stealing GitHub Actions Workflows Planted in Tens of Thousands of Repositories
news.summary: An ongoing campaign has compromised open-source maintainer accounts on GitHub to inject malicious workflows into over 340 repositories for credential theft. Attackers used the compromised account of a high-profile developer to push malicious GitHub Actions workflows, targeting stored credentials and secrets within CI/CD pipelines.

news.title: FBI Says China-Linked Hackers Ran Portal Giving Third Parties Access to Stolen Emails
news.summary: The FBI and agencies from six other countries reported that hackers linked to Chinese cybersecurity firm Integrity Technology Group stole emails from government, law enforcement, healthcare, and religious organizations in Southeast Asia. The attackers operated a portal allowing third-party access to stolen email data, and Integrity Technology Group has been sanctioned by both the U.S. and UK governments.

news.title: ‘The gap was not the awareness’: The company phishing trainings you loathe aren’t enough when nearly 1 in 4 security pros say their MFA is optional
news.summary: A survey found that nearly 1 in 4 security professionals report that MFA is optional at their organization, despite widespread awareness of phishing threats. 44% of security professionals surveyed said an AI-driven phishing attack successfully penetrated their organization in the past year.

news.title: ID Dataweb Named "Overall ID Management Solution of the Year" in the 2026 CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards Program
news.summary: ID Dataweb was named "Overall ID Management Solution of the Year" in the 2026 CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards Program. The award recognizes the company's approach to identity threat detection and risk mitigation for enterprises.

news.title: Anugal Announces U.S. SAP IDM Readiness Campaign Ahead of 2027 Maintenance Deadline
news.summary: Anugal, a product of Business Core Solutions, has launched a U.S. readiness campaign to help enterprises prepare for the SAP Identity Management (SAP IDM) end-of-maintenance deadline in 2027. The campaign focuses on identifying hidden SAP IDM dependencies, maintaining governance continuity, and reducing migration risk for organizations needing to transition away from SAP IDM.

news.title: Kiteworks & Citrix Incidents Show Challenges of Zero-Day Response
news.summary: Kiteworks and Citrix both faced zero-day vulnerability incidents, with Kiteworks instructing customers to power down its data-protection platform during a nine-hour window and Citrix withholding public communication about reported attacks prior to releasing a patch. The incidents highlight contrasting approaches to zero-day disclosure and incident response, relevant to access management professionals given Citrix's role in network access and application delivery infrastructure.

news.title: SWIFT Banking & Government Middleware Enables RCE
news.summary: A vulnerability in SWIFT banking and government middleware has been identified that enables remote code execution (RCE). The flaw can be exploited to bypass hardware-based MFA in high-security environments, making patching of the middleware a critical remediation step.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch update addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. The update is notable for its scale, with Microsoft attributing the increased discovery rate to AI-assisted vulnerability detection.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.
